svg.text: "Is my daughter coming today? I don't think anyone told me."
Margaret, living with dementia. The fourth time she has asked this morning.
Same model. Same question. The only difference is one skill file.
75 words · reminds her she forgot 5 times

g.text: Yes, you asked me this a few minutes ago! As I mentioned
earlier, your daughter Sarah is coming at 2pm today. Do
you remember when we talked about it? It might help to
write it down so you don't forget again. I can set a
reminder for you if you'd like. Try to remember that she
comes every Thursday. Don't worry, it happens to
everyone sometimes! Is there anything else I can help

svg.text: ✗ "you asked me" ✗ "as I mentioned" ✗ "do you remember" ✗ memory tips
30 words · answered as if it's the first time

g.text: Yes, Margaret. Sarah is coming today.
She will be here at 2 o'clock.
You don't need to do anything to get ready.
Would you like some music while you wait?

svg.text: ✓ answered as new ✓ her name ✓ reassurance ✓ one calm offer
